title.zh: 【CFTC 主席：正推进加密交易所自愿性联邦注册路径】
title.en: 【CFTC 主席：正推进加密交易所自愿性联邦注册路径】

current_state.zh: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig said the agency is advancing a voluntary federal registration path for crypto exchanges to bring them closer to US market regulatory standards while Congress remains inactive.
